name: taxpresso
description: Your taxes, done over an espresso. Prepare your Geneva tax return with Claude; your documents stay on this computer.
long_description:
Taxpresso helps you prepare your Geneva tax return (déclaration d'impôt) with Claude. It runs entirely on your computer: it makes no network requests, and your documents never leave your Taxpresso folder unless you ask Claude to read one.

This preview asks the questions that matter for your return, in the chat or in its dashboard, keeps your documents in your Taxpresso folder, reads them with Claude when you ask (you confirm every value), checks them against each other, tells you what is still missing, computes your cantonal, communal and federal tax and explains every figure with its official source, estimates what a pillar 3a payment before 31 December would save you, and later checks your assessment against what you declared.

Taxpresso is free and open source (GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later).

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Where your Geneva tax return stands: household, questions answered, documents, what is still missing and the next step.

tools.name: next_questions
tools.description: The next questions about your situation.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Saves your answer to a question.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Your documents and what each one is.

tools.name: ingest_vault
tools.description: Adds files you put in your Taxpresso folder yourself.

tools.name: compute_tax
tools.description: Your Geneva cantonal, communal and federal tax, computed on this computer, with how each figure is computed and what is still an estimate.

tools.name: get_last_year
tools.description: Last year's figures, read from your previous declaration, to compare with this year.

tools.name: review_last_year
tools.description: Last year's return, reviewed: its tax recomputed, what you could have saved, what to ask yourself, and what you can still do.

tools.name: list_optimizations
tools.description: Ways to lower your tax with their CHF value: before 31 December (pillar 3a, a pension fund buy-in, the 3a catch-up), and TOU if you are taxed at source.

tools.name: decide_optimization
tools.description: Records your own choice about TOU (taxation ordinaire ultérieure), once you have seen the comparison. It never sends anything.

tools.name: set_fact
tools.description: Saves what you tell Claude: a rough figure for the estimates, a value from a document you confirmed or corrected, or a note on something to check.

tools.name: get_document_for_review
tools.description: Shows Claude one of your documents, when you ask: its text, extracted on this computer, or the image of a photo or scan.

tools.name: propose_extraction
tools.description: Saves the values Claude read in a document, with their page and box, for you to confirm.

tools.name: get_form_values
tools.description: The values to type into your declaration by hand, section by section in the official form's order, as in the dashboard's copy panel.

tools.name: get_holdings
tools.description: Your securities list (état des titres) and other wealth: each line, whose it is, its value and income, the withholding tax you get back, and what is missing.

tools.name: set_holding
tools.description: Saves what you tell Claude about your securities and accounts: the official value of a security, whose a line is, or an account or asset without a document.

tools.name: mark_entered
tools.description: Ticks the values you say you typed into your declaration as entered, like the Entered boxes in the dashboard. Values that aren't final yet are left unticked.

tools.name: skip_question
tools.description: Puts a question aside when you don't know the answer yet. It comes back later.

tools.name: waive_requirement
tools.description: Records that you don't have, or don't need, an optional document, or asks for it again.

tools.name: replace_document
tools.description: Records that one of your documents replaces another, such as a corrected salary certificate. The old file stays in your folder.

tools.name: set_document_owner
tools.description: Records whose a document is, when you say so: yours, your partner's or both.

tools.name: reconcile_official_pdf
tools.description: Compares the PDF of your declaration, downloaded from GeTax or the online declaration, with the values you had to type: what differs and what is missing. It never transmits anything.

tools.name: final_check
tools.description: Before you fill in the official form: what to fix first (values to confirm, estimates, open checks, missing documents) and what is good to know (amounts at or near a limit, each with its official source).

tools.name: export_bundle
tools.description: Saves one ZIP file of your tax folder for the year, with your documents, in your Taxpresso folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Opens your Taxpresso dashboard, which runs on this computer only.

prompts.name: start_geneva_tax_return
prompts.description: Begin or pick up your Geneva tax return with Taxpresso.
prompts.text: I want to work on my Geneva tax return with Taxpresso. Check where I am and tell me the next step.

vault_path.title: Taxpresso folder
vault_path.description: Where your tax documents and records are kept. Taxpresso creates it if needed. It is a normal folder you can open and back up; don't choose a folder inside a code project.

ui_language.title: Dashboard language
ui_language.description: en for English, fr for French. Claude answers in the language you write in.
